mapper.select: SELECT I.KPI_SEQ, I.PROCESS_NAME, I.ITEM_NO, I.SORT_ORDER, I.KPI_NAME, I.UNIT, I.AGG_TYPE, P.M1 AS plan_m1, P.M2 AS plan_m2, P.M3 AS plan_m3, P.M4 AS plan_m4, P.M5 AS plan_m5, P.M6 AS plan_m6, P.M7 AS plan_m7, P.M8 AS plan_m8, P.M9 AS plan_m9, P.M10 AS plan_m10, P.M11 AS plan_m11, P.M12 AS plan_m12, A.M1 AS actual_m1, A.M2 AS actual_m2, A.M3 AS actual_m3, A.M4 AS actual_m4, A.M5 AS actual_m5, A.M6 AS actual_m6, A.M7 AS actual_m7, A.M8 AS actual_m8, A.M9 AS actual_m9, A.M10 AS actual_m10, A.M11 AS actual_m11, A.M12 AS actual_m12, ME.MANAGER_NAME AS manager_name, ME.NOTE AS note FROM KPI_ITEM I LEFT JOIN KPI_DATA P ON P.KPI_SEQ = I.KPI_SEQ AND P.YEAR = #{year} AND P.ROW_TYPE = 'PLAN' LEFT JOIN KPI_DATA A ON A.KPI_SEQ = I.KPI_SEQ AND A.YEAR = #{year} AND A.ROW_TYPE = 'ACTUAL' LEFT JOIN KPI_META ME ON ME.KPI_SEQ = I.KPI_SEQ AND ME.YEAR = #{year} ORDER BY I.SORT_ORDER
SELECT DISTINCT YEAR FROM KPI_DATA UNION SELECT DISTINCT YEAR FROM KPI_META ORDER BY YEAR DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KPI_DATA WHERE KPI_SEQ = #{kpi_seq} AND YEAR = #{year} AND ROW_TYPE = #{row_type}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO KPI_DATA (KPI_SEQ, YEAR, ROW_TYPE) VALUES (#{kpi_seq}, #{year}, #{row_type})
mapper.update: UPDATE KPI_DATA SET M${month} = #{value,jdbcType=DOUBLE} WHERE KPI_SEQ = #{kpi_seq} AND YEAR = #{year} AND ROW_TYPE = #{row_type}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KPI_META WHERE KPI_SEQ = #{kpi_seq} AND YEAR = #{year}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO KPI_META (KPI_SEQ, YEAR, MANAGER_NAME, NOTE) VALUES (#{kpi_seq}, #{year}, #{manager_name}, #{note})
mapper.update: UPDATE KPI_META SET MANAGER_NAME = #{manager_name}, NOTE = #{note} WHERE KPI_SEQ = #{kpi_seq} AND YEAR = #{year}
mapper.select: SELECT PROCESS_NAME FROM KPI_ITEM GROUP BY PROCESS_NAME ORDER BY MIN(SORT_ORDER)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KPI_ITEM WHERE PROCESS_NAME = #{process_name}
SELECT ISNULL(MAX(ITEM_NO),0) FROM KPI_ITEM WHERE PROCESS_NAME = #{process_name}
SELECT ISNULL(MAX(SORT_ORDER),0) FROM KPI_ITEM WHERE PROCESS_NAME = #{process_name}
mapper.update: UPDATE KPI_ITEM SET SORT_ORDER = SORT_ORDER + 1 WHERE SORT_ORDER >= #{sort_order}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO KPI_ITEM (PROCESS_NAME, ITEM_NO, SORT_ORDER, KPI_NAME, UNIT, AGG_TYPE) VALUES (#{process_name}, #{item_no}, #{sort_order}, #{kpi_name}, #{unit}, #{agg_type})
mapper.update: UPDATE KPI_ITEM SET KPI_NAME = #{kpi_name}, UNIT = #{unit}, AGG_TYPE = #{agg_type} WHERE KPI_SEQ = #{kpi_seq}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM KPI_DATA WHERE KPI_SEQ = #{kpi_seq}; DELETE FROM KPI_META WHERE KPI_SEQ = #{kpi_seq};
